# Avsnitt 593 - Bästa caset för lycka

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-08-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 593 of the Fill or Kill podcast covers the July AI-sector crash triggered by forced deleveraging (notably Leopold Aschenbrenner's leveraged fund being unwound by Citadel), and the subsequent sharp rebound in AI/hyperscaler names. The hosts stress avoiding leverage, holding cash for opportunistic dips, and playing index-inclusion flows and spin-offs; they are constructive on biotech (especially Abcellera's strong menopause/hot-flash antibody data) and monitor macro catalysts (US CPI, Fed/Warsh, Jackson Hole). Overall a cautiously opportunistic, trading-oriented mood with selective bullishness on biotech and quality private-equity managers.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ABCL — AbbCellera (Abselera) | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Strong Phase 2 hot-flash antibody data: monthly injection, few side effects, no dropouts, better than existing tablets; platform company with ~$500m cash.

#### Reasoning

Host's multi-year conviction case finally validated by strong clinical data. Non-hormonal monthly injection avoids liver side effects of Bayer/Japanese tablets. Large cash runway funds development to the finish; platform (fastest-ever COVID antibody) should command a re-rating vs single-drug biotech. Not sold any despite the run from 2-4 to 9.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Phase 3 data disappoints
- if no partner for the hot-flash candidate materializes
- if cash burn accelerates

> *"det var ju väldigt bra data i alla fall jämfört med de, det finns ju tabletter mot det här... Ett plattformsbolag ska ju värderas annorlunda"*

---

### 🟢 NBIS — Nebius (Nibius) | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Hyperscaler nearly halved on forced AI deleveraging; host bought ~150-160, saw +27% intraday snap-back then +15% more as leverage was flushed and positions moved to stable hands.

#### Reasoning

Classic oversold bounce after forced liquidation (Aschenbrenner unwind) flushed leveraged holders; deleveraging into stable hands set the bottom. Host actively traded it profitably. Note Michael Burry reportedly short, and heavy prior volume at high prices could cap upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-sector deleveraging resumes
- if heavy overhead supply from high-volume levels caps the rally
- if macro/CPI prints hot

> *"när jag landade så var Nibus upp 27%. Så då vräkte jag ut det... och sen gick den väl upp 15% till"*

---

### 🟢 APO — Apollo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large PE manager whose shares have come down with the AI pullback; host finds it attractive if there's another leg up, avoids Private Credit-heavy names but likes Apollo.

#### Reasoning

Big, high-quality PE 'dragons' (Apollo, EQT) sold off with the AI trend. If the crash was a correction rather than the end of the trend, these beaten-down quality managers offer a leg up. Host explicitly avoids higher-risk private-credit names (e.g. Blue Owl) but singles out Apollo as looking interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI/credit trend rolls over rather than resuming
- if private-credit stress spreads to Apollo
- if rates rise

> *"framförallt Apollo har jag tittat på. Jag tycker den såg kul ut."*

---

### 🟡 AZN — AstraZeneca | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Bought on BMS merger rumor after record krona drop on bad study; deal didn't materialize, stock barely rebounded, host roughly break-even. Non-core speculative trade.

#### Reasoning

Opportunistic bounce trade on a beaten-down name (record single-day krona fall on bad study data, then FT merger testballoon). Deal talk fizzled and shares haven't recovered toward pre-debacle levels. Host flags it as a non-core 'kill' — the kind of impulsive trade often closed at the bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- if merger talks are definitively denied
- if further pipeline/study setbacks emerge
- host notes it's outside core business

> *"Köpt Astra på det här budryktet... Ligger väl plus minus noll."*

---
